name: kimi
description: Check Kimi readiness, review verified frozen diffs, and run a foreground task handoff from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare Kimi, review frozen diffs, or hand off one foreground task.
interface.longDescription: Verify local Kimi readiness, run foreground adversarial reviews against a frozen saved diff whose SHA-256 is verified before Kimi starts, and hand off one foreground task with explicit access controls. Background and durable lifecycle APIs are not included.
defaultPrompt: Use Kimi Setup to check readiness, Kimi Review to review a verified frozen diff, or Kimi Task for one foreground task handoff.
